head_commit.message:
Fix v32 dialogue observation timing and preserve release evidence

Observe authored greenhouse speech after the existing trusted return, before its normal lifetime expires. Keep root traversal and all original physics gates. Archive the first v32 failure and the fully verified v31 candidate, deployment, and HTTPS results.
